caption: The drawing depicts a section of a quilt with a focus on a circular patchwork design near the center. The main colors present include light shades of blue, yellow, tan, and off-white, with additional patches in red, green, orange, and patterned fabrics. The quilt is composed of various geometric sections, including a large circle made up of eight wedge-shaped segments in different colors and patterns, radiating outward from a central point. The quilt is bordered with a thick yellow strip, quilted with stitched diamond shapes and other linear patterns. The fabric’s surface appears wrinkled and textured, with visible stitched lines throughout. A corner of the quilt is turned up, showing a lighter underside with parallel stitched lines. The background remains plain, highlighting the quilt and its details.
title: Pieced Quilt - "Star Pattern"
